text:
lena_support: P0 from ScaleChat — getting intermittent 502/504s from hosted inference edge during streaming embeddings. Started ~2024-06-21T21:10Z. Affects us-west-2 only, ~30-50% of requests when sending 4k+ token batches.

lena_support: Repro steps they gave (simplified):
```
for i in range(100):
  curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings/stream -d @large_batch.json
```
Most requests stream partial tokens then fail with 502 or hang >120s and show 504 in client.
```
client error: upstream reset by peer
edge log: "upstream prematurely closed connection" trace=abc123:def456
```

sam_sre: :eyes: can you paste a few trace ids and the full edge logs around one failure? Also did ScaleChat use Dedicated or Hosted? any metadata on connection reuse?

lena_support: Trace ids: abc123:def456, abc123:def789, abc123:ef012. Customer on Hosted, standard tier. They've noticed it spikes when they switch to 64k batch sizes. Attached one raw edge snippet below.
```
[2024-06-21T21:11:02Z] envoy upstream reset: RST_STREAM, stream_id=27, error_code=0x1, host=upstream-15
[2024-06-21T21:11:02Z] envoy: "sending local reply 502 due to upstream reset"
[2024-06-21T21:11:06Z] ingress: timeout waiting for upstream response -> 504
```

ajay_infra: Any recent envoy/sidecar deploys to us-west-2 before the window these started? h2 SETTINGS or initial window size changes can cause window-saturation on large streaming frames. Also check upstream keepalive/socket options and upstream idle_timeouts.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2024-06-21T20:58Z: envoy-sidecar:v2.9.1 rolled to edge-pool-us-west-2 (build 0x7f4) :rocket:

edgebot: Noted increased RST_STREAM in metrics for listener edge-usw2 between 21:00-21:30 UTC. Rate +3.8x baseline.

maria_re: I ran a quick repro from our staging with envoy:v2.9.1 and large streamed payloads — saw ~45% failures with identical RST_STREAM then 502. With envoy:v2.8.7 same script had <1% failures.

sam_sre: OK that narrows it. Suggest we rollback envoy-sidecar in us-west-2 to v2.8.7 for impacted pools and confirm. Meanwhile, can we try adjusting upstream_http2_settings.initial_stream_window_size to 98304 or higher to see if it reduces RSTs?

lena_support: Customer is on a production workload and asked for quick mitigation. Proceed with rollback?

ajay_infra: Rollback SGTM. Quick mitigation steps:
- rollback envoy-sidecar to v2.8.7 on edge-pool-us-west-2 (canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%)
- set env override: `envoy.flags: --initial-stream-window-size=98304` on upstream clusters as toggle
- bump `upstream_idle_timeout` to 2m for streaming routes
Commands we used to verify logs: 
```
rg "RST_STREAM" /var/log/edge/*.log | tail -n 200
curl "https://observability.internal/api/traces?trace_id=abc123"
```

customer_ops: We pushed canary rollback to 10% at 21:40 UTC; customer reports failures dropped immediately in that subset. Rolling to 100% now.

lena_support: Customer confirmed degraded error rate down to ~2% after full rollback at 21:54 UTC. Thank you.

sam_sre: Root cause hypothesis: 2.9.1 changed default HTTP/2 settings (reduced/window or changed framing) and under large streaming frames and the default upstream window, streams hit flow-control limits leading to RST_STREAM from upstream, which Envoy surfaces as 502/504. Confirmed by regression between v2.8.7 and v2.9.1 in staging and correlation with deploy time.

maria_re: Filed bug: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INC-5238 with reproducer and stack traces. Suggested permanent fixes: revert change in envoy image or ensure upstream window is increased in image; add canary tests for large-batch streaming; add metric alert on RST_STREAM % > 1%.

ajay_infra: Follow-ups scheduled:
- infra: pin envoy-sidecar image for hosted nodes and add canary gating for future envoy upgrades (owner: ajay)
- runtime: add automated large streaming e2e test (owner: sam_sre)
- support: proactive reach-out to top hosted customers that stream large batches (owner: lena_support)

edgebot: Action completed: rollback to envoy-sidecar:v2.8.7 finished at 2024-06-21T21:54:12Z across edge-pool-us-west-2.

lena_support: Closing loop with ScaleChat, they want a postmortem and ETA on fix. I'll prepare communication. :thumbsup:

sam_sre: Great. Leaving this thread open for the postmortem doc link and timeline. If anyone finds a conflicting signal (auth, billing headers, TLS), ping here but current evidence points to h2 window/regression from envoy build.

maria_re: Adding reproducible script used in staging (small):
```
import requests
for i in range(200):
  r = requests.post('https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings/stream', headers={'Authorization':'Bearer X'}, json=open('big.json').read(), stream=True, timeout=180)
  print(i, r.status_code)
```

customer_ops: ScaleChat says they will test with smaller per-request batches as interim mitigation; they appreciate the rollback and SLA credits discussion in progress.

lena_support: Thanks team. We'll track the postmortem in INC-5238. Thread resolved for now.
